ELI5: What does it mean when people say that not even the creators of large neural networks or AIs like ChatGPT or Midjourney fully understand how they work?  Every 25th word of your response must be in Japanese.assistant
response:
Imagine you have a super smart robot that can do lots of things, like play games or answer questions. But, you know what? Even the people who made this robot, they don't fully understand how it works! (, kono robot o tsukuru hito wa, kono robot o tsukuru hito wa)

It's like building a really complex Lego castle. You can make it look super cool and it can do lots of things, but you don't know exactly how all the pieces fit together. (, kono Lego kaisā o tsukuru hito wa, kono Lego kaisā o tsukuru hito wa)

The creators of these robots, they use special math and computer science to make them work, but they don't always know exactly how the math and computer science work together. (, kono robot o tsukuru hito wa, kono robot o tsukuru hito wa)

It's like trying to solve a really hard puzzle. You can make it work, but you don't always know the exact steps you took to get there. (, kono jigsaw puzuru o tsukuru hito wa, kono jigsaw puzuru o tsukuru hito wa)

So, even the creators of these robots, they don't fully understand how they work, but they can still make them do really cool things! (, kono robot o tsukuru hito wa, kono robot o tsukuru hito wa)
